stateCode.title: State
stateCode.description: Two-letter US state code to survey all active monitoring sites in, e.g. "CO". Ignored if "siteNumbers" is set.

siteNumbers.title: Site numbers
siteNumbers.description: Comma-separated USGS site numbers to check instead of a whole state, e.g. "07227420,09404200". Takes priority over "stateCode" if both are set.

parameter.title: Parameter
parameter.description: Which reading to fetch. Gauge height is water surface elevation (best for flood/high-water risk); streamflow (discharge) is volume of water passing the site per second.

minValue.title: Minimum value
minValue.description: Only return sites whose latest reading is at or above this value. Leave blank to return all sites, highest reading first.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of sites to return, highest reading first.
